source_instruction: i am looking for light blonde hair extensions that are 18 inches long.
query:
Ugh, I swear my neighbor’s golden retriever has been staging a full-on heist of my backyard tomato plants all week. I caught him red-pawed yesterday with a whole sun-warmed cherry tomato cluster hanging out of his mouth, sitting right on my patio like he owned the place, and when I tried to gently shoo him off he just wagged his tail so hard he knocked over my favorite potted mint. I ended up giving him a tiny piece of the tomato he’d already half-snatched because he looked so proud of himself, and now he keeps showing up at my back fence every couple hours staring at me like we’re business partners in the tomato operation now. I even had to prop a little folding chair out there for five minutes this morning just to watch for him, because half my ripe tomatoes were already gone before I noticed what was happening.
Hey, I’m browsing the hair loss products section right now and I need to grab some hair toppers, 18 inch length, in that one color I always get, plus it has to come with a free satin storage pouch, and my total can’t go over $60. I’ve been meaning to pick these up for weeks since my last set got all tangled up when I took it to the beach last weekend, so I don’t wanna spend too long scrolling if you can pull up the right matches quick. Wait, make sure the length is definitely 18 inches, I don’t want anything shorter that won’t blend right with my current layers, and don’t show me anything that goes over my $60 budget either.

extras.text: it has to come with a free satin storage pouch
